chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 272: The Descent of the Reborn Half-Ancestors
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen witnesses the rebirth of Buddha, Primordial, and Tongtian as children. A failed gambit triggers an epic battle between half-ancestors and Otherworld gods.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 272: Reborn Half-Ancestors
og_description: The reborn half-ancestors clash with Otherworld golden chariots. Xiao Chen learns that the world may be an illusion. An ancestral god from the Eternal Continent appears.
